dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Ah, hello there, Traveler. Well, I... Um... I'm trying to make some fertilizer.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: I heard from someone that someone from Sumeru has set up a fertilizer shop in Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: They say that these fertilizers have unusual properties. As long as you add a little when growing plants, they will grow exceedingly lushly.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: But I can't go to Ritou to purchase that fertilizer, so I tried making my own here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You figured out how to make some yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Actually, no... I asked around everywhere before coming up with this method myself.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: To get into the specifics, you want to mix some crops and some, ah, animal excrement together into a pile.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: Afterward, you cover it with a layer of branches and leaves and such to maintain the temperature.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: After a while, they say that the ingredients will undergo some changes and even blend together, forming a sort of fertilizer.

dialogues.speaker: Iwata
dialogues.text: But no matter how much I experiment, these materials just won't come together. It's really strange...

choices.text: Do you have the wrong ingredients by any chance?

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: Crops, animal excrement, branches and leaves... Should be correct. That's what I've heard, at least.

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: Forget it. Let me just try again. Traveler, could I ask you for a favor?

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: I'll make another batch of fertilizer. Once it's done, I'd like you to check on it together with me.

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: Given how much you've seen and learned, you might know what went wrong during the process.

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: Alright, I'm counting on you, Traveler! I'll make some preparations over there first.

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: Making this sort of fertilizer requires some time, so please come find me in a bit. Until then, please help me watch that fertilizer pile.

choices.text: Did something go wrong during the process?

response.speaker: Iwata
response.text: Pile the materials up, cover with branches to maintain their temperature. No, this should be correct...
